question: Define the three ANSI SQL read phenomena: Dirty Read, Non-Repeatable Read, and Phantom Read.
category: Define the three ANSI SQL read phenomena: Dirty Read, Non-Repeatable Read, and Phantom Read.?

options.text: Dirty Read: reading uncommitted changes; Non-Repeatable Read: re-reading a row returns modified values; Phantom Read: re-executing range query returns newly inserted rows.
